title: juniperus vulgaris
intro: Juniperus vulgaris, commonly known as the common juniper or savin juniper, is a small evergreen tree or shrub native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. This plant is known for its health benefits, including its ability to treat digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and lower blood pressure due to its diuretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Juniperus vulgaris include its use as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, which helps to relieve respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenes, flavonoids, and lignans, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
